turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm moving abroad next month and I can't take my game collection. There's about forty games.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a hard goodbye. Do you want to sell them online for some money, or donate them somewhere like a local school or youth club?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on, I'm going to chat with my friend for a bit. Just wait until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Leo, which stop do we get off at for the museum?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I think it's the one after the big park. Central Square?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are you sure? The map says there's a stop called Museum Road.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Oh, maybe that's closer. Let me look.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Okay, Museum Road then. Get ready, it's coming up fast.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Leo, what's the name of the bakery on the corner?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I always forget, the one with the blue sign.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I'm back now. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. We'd left the forty games hanging. What's their fate?
